intro: Choeng Mon sits on the northeast tip of Koh Samui, just north of Lamai and Chaweng and very close to the Big Buddha and the airport. People come for the small curved bay, where the water is calmer than Chaweng's, shallow and clear, and easy to wade into. At low tide you can even walk out to the little Koh Fan Noi islet in the middle of the bay. The mood is quiet and relaxed, with upscale resorts spread along the sand and a handful of seafood spots and small bars. Anyone who wants more buzz, shops, and nightlife usually takes the roughly 10-minute ride to Chaweng. There's no convenient public transport here, so getting around means hotel shuttles, a taxi, Grab, or a rented scooter.

blocks.html: Short answer: Choeng Mon is a calm bay on Samui's northeast tip, only about 5–10 minutes from the airport. It has a soft white-sand beach, gentle water that's shallow and safe for kids, and a quiet, upscale mood. It suits couples and families who want a genuine rest. Stays run from beachfront bungalows around ฿1,500 to five-figure pool-villa resorts.

items.name: Samui Honey Cottages Beach Resort
items.meta: ★ 3-star · Best for: Budget · beachfront bungalows · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A budget bungalow resort set right on Choeng Mon Beach. Rooms are stand-alone cottages in a leafy garden, with a pool and a beachside restaurant. Reviews praise the on-the-sand location and the value, though some note the rooms and pool area are starting to show their age and could use a refresh. A good fit for couples or families who want a quiet beachfront base without a high price.

items.name: PS Thana Resort
items.meta: ★ 3-star · Best for: Value · big pool, quiet · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A small beachfront resort on Choeng Mon that rates highly for its price band. The draws are a large, well-kept pool and a very quiet stretch of private beach. Rooms are spacious and clean, some with a small kitchen, and the staff and breakfast get frequent praise. A few areas show their age. Best for couples or families who want calm and a generous pool.

items.name: Imperial Boat House Beach Resort
items.meta: ★ 4-star · Best for: Families · teak-barge rooms · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A Choeng Mon beachfront resort with an unusual signature: some suites are converted from old teak rice barges, and the main pool is shaped like a boat. The grounds are large, with several restaurants and water activities like kayaks and snorkel gear. Reviews praise the service and beachfront setting, though some room blocks are a fair walk from the sand. A fun pick for families who want something different.

items.name: Melia Koh Samui
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Families · multiple pools · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 5-star resort on Choeng Mon Beach known for its multiple pools, including a long river-like one that both kids and adults enjoy. Rooms are large, well-designed, and well-maintained, and there are several on-site restaurants. The beach in front is quiet with shallow water. Reviews rate the pools, breakfast, and staff highly. A strong choice for families and couples who want a full-service beachfront resort.

items.name: Kimpton Kitalay Samui by IHG
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Couples · new design-led resort · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A recently opened oceanfront resort from the Kimpton brand. The highlight is a modern design with Thai accents, roomy rooms and villas, a large pool, a water-play area, and several restaurants and bars including a beach bar. Recent reviews score the location, attentive service, and breakfast highly. Best for couples who want a newer, contemporary resort on the water.

items.name: SALA Samui Choengmon Beach Resort
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Couples · private pool villas · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A luxury villa resort on Choeng Mon Beach where most accommodations are villas with a private pool. The design is clean, white, and modern, and the outdoor bathrooms draw frequent praise. It recently earned Two Keys from the MICHELIN Guide. There's a beachfront pool and a spa. Reviews highlight the privacy and design, though food and spa prices run high. Best for couples and honeymooners who want a quiet villa by the sea.

items.name: Garrya Tongsai Bay Samui
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Luxury · private quiet bay · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A luxury resort spread across Tongsai Bay, the cove next to Choeng Mon, with a long private beach and large green grounds on a hillside that make it feel very secluded. It has two pools, a spa, and three restaurants, with spacious rooms and villas that have sea-view terraces. Reviews praise the calm, the views, and the attentive staff. Best for couples or anyone who wants real quiet and privacy. It's the priciest option in the area.

faq.q: Who is Choeng Mon for, and how does it differ from Chaweng?
faq.a: Choeng Mon is a quiet, fairly upscale bay with gentle, shallow water, well suited to couples and families with young kids who want a real rest. Chaweng, about 10 minutes away, is far livelier, with more restaurants, malls, and nightlife. If you want calm evenings but still easy access to Chaweng, Choeng Mon is a good middle ground.

faq.q: How close is Choeng Mon to Samui Airport, and is it easy to get around?
faq.a: Choeng Mon is very close to Samui Airport, about a 5–10 minute drive, which is handy on arrival and departure days. There's no strong public transport, though, so reaching Chaweng, Lamai, or other sights usually means a hotel shuttle, taxi, or Grab. If you plan several days of island sightseeing, renting a scooter or car is more flexible and cheaper.

faq.q: Is Choeng Mon beach good for swimming, and is it suitable for kids?
faq.a: Choeng Mon is a curved bay with gentle waves and shallow water, so it's easy and fairly safe for children to swim. At low tide the water gets very shallow, and in places you can walk out to the Koh Fan Noi islet in the bay. The sand is fine and white and the setting is calm, which suits families. Anyone wanting surf or full-on water sports may prefer Chaweng.
